create_ytvis_instance: create a YTVIS instance by loading a YouTubeVIS annotation JSON file into memory
get_ann_ids_by_filter: get annotation ids filtered by video ids, category ids, area range, or crowd label
load_results_and_index: load algorithm result file and create a YTVIS API object with indexed annotations
convert_annotation_to_mask: convert a video annotation segmentation at a frame id to a binary numpy mask
get_category_ids_by_name: get category ids filtered by category names, supercategory names, or category ids
